{{Top|leg}}
'''Trade Alliance Security''' was the security division of the [[Cularin Trade Alliance]], a trading concern that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A number of members of Trade Alliance Security attended the [[Cularin Trade Show]], a trade show that was held aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[TAV Prosperity|TAV ''Prosperity'']], and after the event was disrupted by the [[Metatheran Cartel]], a Cartel operative was apprehended by Trade Alliance Security.
